text: I can walk through both phases of 2PC, name its commit point and estimate its added latency and lock time.
I can explain with a timeline why 2PC blocks when the coordinator dies after PREPARE, and how a replicated coordinator fixes it.
I can design a saga with a pivot, compensations for every earlier step and irreversible effects placed after the pivot.
I can choose between orchestration and choreography for a given flow and explain why choreography needs an outbox.
I can propose a design that avoids a distributed transaction, such as co-locating data, reservations or reconciliation.
